answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral. An attacker must acquire a karst of wealth to gain proportional influence, rendering the cost of creating a sonnet of fake identities prohibitively expensive. By linking voting power to a cryptographically verified cipher of held assets, the network ensures that any attempt to flood the system with Sybil nodes forces the adversary to exhaust their own resources, effectively aligning economic incentives with consensus security.
